title: EffiBench-X: A Multi-Language Benchmark for Measuring Efficiency of LLM-Generated Code
authors_zh: Yuhao Qing, Boyu Zhu, Mingzhe Du, Zhijiang Guo, Terry Yue Zhuo, Qianru Zhang, Jie M. Zhang, Heming Cui, Siu-Ming Yiu, Dong Huang, See-Kiong Ng, Luu Anh Tuan
paper_type_zh: 跨语言、执行式代码效率基准
best_for_zh: 研究代码优化、效率奖励和跨语言代码生成的研究者。
one_line: EffiBench-X tests whether correct code approaches expert runtime and memory efficiency across six languages.
EffiBench-X 检验通过功能测试的代码能否在六种语言中接近专家的运行时间与内存效率。
why: It turns code efficiency into a verifiable outcome rather than treating functional correctness as sufficient.
inclusion_reason: EffiBench-X supplies code records with programmatic correctness gates and resource-efficiency scores across six languages.

title: Problem
问题
html: Code-generation benchmarks usually check only whether tests pass, so functionally correct but extremely slow or memory-heavy programs receive full credit. Existing efficiency evaluations are also mostly Python-only. EffiBench-X provides a unified execution environment for six languages and uses expert competitive-programming solutions as efficiency baselines, measuring runtime, peak memory, and memory integral after candidates pass 100 tests. This separates correctness from efficiency.
代码生成 benchmark 通常只判断答案是否通过测试，功能正确但时间或内存极差的程序仍得满分；现有效率评测又多局限 Python，无法比较模型在不同语言和运行时上的优化能力。EffiBench-X 构建六语言统一执行环境，以人类竞赛解作为效率基线，在候选通过 100 个测试后测量运行时间、峰值内存和内存积分，从而把正确性与效率分开。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: EffiBench-X contains 623 competitive-programming problems with 100 tests each across Python, C++, Java, JavaScript, Ruby, and Go, retaining human expert implementations as normalized baselines. The executor first compiles or runs candidates in a sandbox and checks every output. Only functionally correct programs enter repeated performance measurement, producing relative time and memory efficiency. Records include problems, tests, language templates, expert solutions, and execution assets for optimization benchmarks, best-of-N, and efficiency rewards.

EffiBench-X 含 623 道竞赛编程题，每题配 100 个测试，支持 Python、C++、Java、JavaScript、Ruby 和 Go，并保留人类专家实现作为归一化基线。执行器先在沙箱编译/运行并检查所有输出；只有功能正确的候选才进入多次性能测量，最终形成相对时间和内存效率。数据记录包括题目、测试、语言模板、专家解和运行资产，适合代码优化 benchmark、best-of-N 与效率奖励。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Select problems and expert solutions: Curate contest problems implementable across languages and retain high-quality human submissions.
  1. Build strong tests: Prepare 100 inputs per problem covering scale and edge cases, verifying consistency across six-language references.
  1. Filter functionality: Compile and run candidates in a common sandbox; any failed test marks the program incorrect.
  1. Measure performance: Repeatedly run correct programs, record runtime, peak memory, and memory integral, and normalize against expert baselines. Reproduction must fix CPUs, compilers, runtimes, warm-up, and timeouts.

1. 选择题目与专家解： 从竞赛平台筛选可跨语言实现的问题，保存高质量人类提交。
  1. 构造强测试： 每题整理 100 个覆盖规模与边界的输入，并验证六语言参考解一致。
  1. 功能过滤： 在统一沙箱编译运行候选，任一测试失败即记为不正确。
  1. 性能测量： 对正确程序重复运行，记录时间、peak memory 与 memory integral，并相对专家基线归一化。复现需固定 CPU、编译器、运行时、预热和超时。

title: Evidence
证据
html: NeurIPS 2025 results show that models often produce correct code but remain consistently less efficient than humans; even the strongest Qwen3-32B solutions reach only about 62% of human efficiency on average. Language effects are substantial: models tend to do relatively better in Python, Ruby, and JavaScript and worse in Java, C++, and Go, with rankings changing across languages. This supports multilingual efficiency evaluation, although absolute runtime depends strongly on hardware and implementation details.
NeurIPS 2025 结果显示模型经常能生成正确代码，却普遍低于人类效率；最有效的模型 Qwen3-32B 平均也仅达到约 62% 的人类效率。语言差异明显：模型通常在 Python、Ruby、JavaScript 上相对较好，在 Java、C++、Go 上更弱，同一模型的跨语言排序也会变化。该证据支持多语言效率评测，但绝对运行时间高度依赖硬件和实现细节。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier efficiency and code benchmarks focus on one language or runtime, while cross-language comparisons use different tasks and tests. EffiBench-X executes the same 623 problems, input semantics, and expert baselines in six languages and adds peak memory and memory integral. It is not a new code generator; it defines a second verifier layer requiring resource efficiency after functional correctness.
早期 EffiBench 和代码 benchmark 主要聚焦单语言或运行时间，跨语言比较常因题目和测试不同而不可比。EffiBench-X 的新意是对同一 623 题、同一输入语义和专家基线运行六种语言，并把 peak memory 与 memory integral 纳入。它不是新代码生成模型，而是把“通过测试后还要接近专家资源效率”定义为第二层 verifier。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Machine dependence: Runtime and memory depend on CPU, OS, compiler, and JIT, so numbers from different machines are not directly comparable.
  1. Contest bias: Tasks emphasize algorithmic complexity and omit repository optimization, services, GPUs, and maintainability.
  1. Expert baselines: Human submissions may not be theoretically optimal, and implementation quality varies by language. Reuse should fix hardware and report confidence intervals rather than one-run ratios.

1. 机器依赖： 运行时间和内存受 CPU、OS、编译器与 JIT 影响，跨机器数字不能直接比较。
  1. 竞赛偏置： 题目强调算法复杂度，未覆盖仓库优化、I/O 服务、GPU 和可维护性。
  1. 专家基线： 人类提交未必是理论最优，语言实现质量也不完全一致。复用时应固定硬件并报告置信区间，而非只给单次比值。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Evaluate code optimization: Filter by correctness first, then compare time and memory efficiency across six languages.
  1. Efficiency rewards: Reward candidates relative to expert performance only after all tests pass, preventing speed gains through wrong output.
  1. Cross-language analysis: Study model bias for the same algorithms across runtimes. Repository performance or GPU kernels require appropriate workloads; contest efficiency should not be extrapolated to production systems.

1. 评测代码优化： 先按 correctness 过滤，再比较六语言时间与内存效率。
  1. 效率奖励： 对通过全部测试的候选按相对专家性能赋 reward，避免模型以错误输出换速度。
  1. 跨语言分析： 研究同一算法在不同运行时的模型偏差。若目标是仓库级性能或 GPU kernel，应使用相应 workload；不得把竞赛题效率直接外推到生产系统。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. One-sentence position: EffiBench-X compares resource efficiency of correct code on 623 problems, 100 tests each, and six languages.
  2. Method takeaway: Strong tests, correctness gating, repeated timing, memory measurement, and expert normalization.
  3. Data takeaway: Problems, tests, expert solutions, and six-language execution assets are public.
  4. Evidence anchor: Qwen3-32B reaches only about 62% of human efficiency on average, with large language effects.
  5. Reuse decision: It fits algorithmic code efficiency when machines and compilers are fixed.

1. 一句话定位： EffiBench-X 用 623 题、每题 100 测试比较六语言正确代码的资源效率。
  2. 方法抓手： 强测试、功能门控、重复计时、内存测量和专家归一化。
  3. 数据抓手： 题目、测试、专家解与六语言执行资产完整公开。
  4. 证据锚点： Qwen3-32B 平均仅约 62% 人类效率，语言差异显著。
  5. 复用决定： 适合算法代码效率；必须固定机器和编译器。
